plain: A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino talks about Karla Turner, an author who wrote books such as Taken and Into the Fringe about people who say they were abducted. Alberino says what made Turner unique was that she herself and her family were abductees, taken both by aliens and in what are called MILAB cases, meaning abductions said to involve military people. If true, it would mean she wrote from inside the experience, not just as an outside researcher.
